metaDescription: Order custom 3/4 sleeve products with your logo. Perfect for team uniforms and promotional apparel. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom 3/4 sleeve products offer a versatile look that bridges short sleeves and long sleeves, making them ideal for seasonal promotions or uniform programs. Whether you're outfitting a marketing team for a spring event or providing comfortable apparel for a safety crew, the 3/4 sleeve length provides a polished appearance with added coverage. These garments work well with screen printing or embroidery on the sleeve or chest.
heroAltText: Custom 3/4 sleeve products including polo shirts and jerseys with printed logos for promotional use
